critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/hair_colors.py public_face_check: on any LLM exception it falls back to {face:true, presentation:'unclear', hair_length:'unclear', reason:'unverified'} — this is user-friendly but silently masks emergentintegrations outages and lets non-faces through. Consider adding a lightweight retry (1x) before the optimistic fallback, and log the raw response for observability.

backend/routes/hair_colors.py public_face_check: no rate limiting on this public endpoint despite it invoking a paid vision model per call. Add a per-IP bucket similar to the /api/public/book rate-limit (e.g., 20/10min) to prevent trivial abuse of the LLM key.

backend/routes/hair_colors.py: Pydantic FaceCheckIn has max_length=3_000_000 but no minimum length; the len(b64) < 2000 check is done manually after base64 split — fine, but consider Field(min_length=2000) so the 400 comes from FastAPI validation with a clearer error body.

frontend/src/pages/ColorTryOn.jsx capture(): analyseSkin() runs BEFORE the /face-check call, so if the fake/dim frame fails skin-read the user never gets the specific 'No face detected' AI message even when the real culprit is no face; consider always calling face-check first (or in parallel) and prioritise its 'face:false' error over the on-device skin read error for better UX/messaging.

frontend/src/pages/ColorTryOn.jsx: faceInfo text uses hard-coded emoji '✓' and mixes 'looks like a man/woman' — inclusive-language nit: consider 'appears feminine/masculine presentation' or expose the 'unclear' presentation explicitly instead of omitting the phrase.
